integrity.claim_consistency: all statements concern exact deterministic two-step binary rotation separation and the three-state census

scientific_limitations: Only binary words and a left cyclic shift by exactly two positions are classified.
The closed 31-state certificate proves the infinite transformation-monoid lemma; finite word enumeration alone is not used as an infinite proof.
Neither all larger shifts nor nondeterministic separation is determined.
Unindexed or unpublished independent results may affect publication priority.
title: Sharp three-state separation and an exact census for two-step binary rotations
